_about: Single source of truth for changeable facts. tools/verify_master.py checks that index.html, lang/*.json, privacy.html and the JS files agree with these values. Not loaded by the browser. Fill a null value only after it is verified.

site._about: V2: v2/tools/build_site.py reads this file at build time; values reach every page from here only.
site._consent_mode_options: advanced = Google tags load with all consent types denied and send cookieless pings until the visitor accepts (V1 production behaviour). basic = Google tags are not loaded and no event is queued until the visitor accepts. 2027 decision (QA revision 2026-10-06): basic.

market._about: Reservation-channel ORDER only — never content, price or property. Signal priority: (A) explicit URL ?ph_market=tr|intl (e.g. future TR-targeted Ads URLs; Ads not changed), (B) LOW-CONFIDENCE hint: browser time zone in hint_time_zones, (C) no signal = neutral. Time zone is a hint, not a country: no IP, no geolocation API/permission, no GPS, no fingerprint, no third-party geo service. Browser language alone is never used. Booking.com is never hidden or removed; only order and one note change. Used only while booking_turkey_restriction.enabled is true.

booking_turkey_restriction._about: Booking.com does not currently offer bookings for properties in Turkey to users located in Turkey. enabled=true → TR-hint channel order, the Booking note and the FAQ item are built. enabled=false → every visitor gets the neutral order, no note, no FAQ item and no market logic in the page (rebuild only, no code change).
booking_turkey_restriction.source: Owner report (Ali) + task brief 2026-10-06; public Booking.com behaviour for users in Turkey. Re-check before the 2027 season.

address.street: Göynük Mah. 3270. Sok. B Blok No:1

booking_links._about: Parameters used by the V2 reservation links (same as the production smart redirect).

booking.rules: Use only '9.4 on Booking.com' / '9.4 / 10'. review_count stays null and is not shown: Booking's public/search surfaces can show different (cached) counts; add it only after reading it on the canonical property page and setting show_review_count. No verbal label (Exceptional etc.) until Booking's own label is verified. No reviewCount / aggregateRating until the count is verified.

airbnb.rules: Score stays null until Ali reads it on the live Airbnb listing. While null the site shows only the platform attribution and a link, never a number.

google.rules: Overall Google score stays null until read on the real Business Profile. Individual ratings live in platform_reviews.

google_business._about: Real Google Business Profile of Palmiye Home. place_id provided by Helpy and VERIFIED on Google Maps 2026-10-06 (opens 'Palmiye Home · Günlük Kiralık Daire', 3270 Sokak, Göynük, 07980 Kemer/Antalya; website palmiyehomekemer.com; phone 0532 778 67 32; coordinates identical to property.geo). Links use the documented Google Maps URLs API: search with query + query_place_id, directions with destination + destination_place_id. profile_url stays null (no canonical share URL provided; not invented).
google_business.consistency_note: GBP address reads 'Dış Kapı:1B, Göynük, 3270 Sokak İç Kapı:1, 07980 Kemer/Antalya'; the site uses 'Göynük Mah. 3270. Sok. B Blok No:1, 07980 Kemer / Antalya'. Same place; Ali to decide whether to align the wording.

platform_reviews._about: Real ratings from independent platforms other than the two Booking quotes. Never write text for a rating that has none (text: null).

items.author: Hamza Konak
items.source: Provided by Ali (Google review, 5 stars, no written text) — 2026-10-06

direct_testimonials._about: Direct / WhatsApp testimonials. Shown ONLY when consent_confirmed is true (written permission from the guest to publish). Private WhatsApp messages are never published without it.

review_themes._about: Preparation for review intelligence (cleanliness, quietness, pool, kitchen, wifi, self_checkin, communication, location). Tags are assigned only from what a real review actually says. No aggregate claim ('guests love X') may be made from these tags until a real dataset exists.

guest_reviews._about: Verbatim guest reviews already published on the live site (source: Booking.com). Shown in the original language; never translated, edited or invented. 'excerpt' = verbatim sentences cut from 'text' (verify_v2.py checks each one is an exact substring); the card links to the full reviews on Booking.com.

items.author: Roman
excerpt: The apartment was modern, stylish and comfortable, with a fully functional kitchen including stove, oven and dishwasher.
The Wi-Fi was reliable and fast.
items.text: We recently spent a week at this apartment, and our experience was nothing short of delightful. The apartment was modern, stylish and comfortable, with a fully functional kitchen including stove, oven and dishwasher. The Wi-Fi was reliable and fast. Just an 8-minute walk from Migros and Bim shops. A special mention goes to Meltem, who truly made our stay exceptional — incredibly responsive and kind. Highly recommend!

items.author: Dudojc
items.text: Ruhige Gegend und alles Neubau. Küchengeräte alles Neue, wir haben das Gefühl gehabt das wir dieses Apartment als erste nutzen. Pool Neu und Top sauber. Das war unser bester Unterkunft seit 15 Jahren, und wir machen jährlich Urlaub. Können wir nur empfehlen :-)

policies.parking: Free open-air parking within the property (same wording as the live site FAQ; Google Business Profile attribute still to be compared)

pool._about: Seasonal outdoor pool — COPY ONLY. POOL STATUS != APARTMENT AVAILABILITY: nothing here ever closes a date; the apartment is bookable inside availability.booking_window whatever the pool does. reference_opening_date is a conservative operating reference, never shown as a guaranteed opening. When the pool really opens (it may open earlier, late April / early May, if maintenance and weather allow), set confirmed_opening_date (and status 'open') and rebuild: the text switches to the confirmed date. Maintenance closures of the apartment are blocked in Booking.com / Airbnb, never hard-coded here.

availability._about: Availability engine (server side, v2/src/server/api/_lib/availability.php). Feeds: Booking.com iCal + Airbnb iCal ONLY (no third/Direct calendar: a confirmed WhatsApp/direct booking is blocked by the owner in Booking.com or Airbnb). A night closed in EITHER feed is closed on the website. Both feed URLs are SECRETS and live only in palmiye-secrets/.env.php outside the web root. This block holds only non-secret behaviour. booking_window = the outer range in which the website evaluates stays (decision 2026-10-06: the whole of 2027, so early bookings for summer and off-season / holiday stays are possible). It is NOT the pool season, NOT a tourism season and NOT daily availability: daily availability comes only from the union of the two feeds. Outside the window the calendar shows 'not open yet'; null = nothing is shown as free (fail-safe).

tracking._rule: Production values verified in the Google Ads / GA4 accounts on 2026-10-02. Do not change or rename.
